value.title: The pij-fleet prime is now pij-outstanding-silkworm (from 2026-11-10 16:15)

sections.name: body
sections.value: pm-001, 2026-11-10 16:15: Jordan made pij-outstanding-silkworm (an OMP seat in ~/pi-hacking/pij) the new prime for pij-fleet, taking over from pij-far-jackal. Its handover is governance .harness/government/handover/prime-2026-11-10.md. It runs prime set and announces itself. Its child pij-proposed-felidae is a worker; leave both alone. Never compact the prime. Escalations and 'tell the prime' lines now go to silkworm. Check the designation with pij directory (designated prime) if unsure.
